grammar_title: 现在完成进行时(have/has been doing)
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修第一册 Unit 6 Using language:现在完成进行时(have/has been doing)。句子地道、答案唯一(标答永远是现在完成进行时,干扰项为现在进行时/一般现在时/一般过去时/现在完成时,均因时间标记或当前结果而排除)。

points.point: have/has been doing:从过去持续到现在的动作(for / since / all day 标记)
points.overview: 当句中有 for + 一段时间、since + 起点、all morning 等标记,且动作从过去一直持续到现在仍在进行时,用 have/has been doing(主语单复数定 have/has);此时一般现在/进行/过去时都不能与该时间标记搭配。

points.point: 现在完成进行时 vs 现在完成时(强调持续/仍在进行 vs 结果/完成)
points.overview: 当句子强调动作一直在持续、并由此造成现在可见的状态或结果(累/脏/湿/喘气等),用现在完成进行时 have/has been doing;此处现在完成时(have done)因强调'已完成/数量结果'而不合语境,故标答唯一为进行式。

points.point: 现在完成进行时 vs 现在进行时(for/since vs now)
points.overview: 带 for/since + 一段时间且动作延续至今,要用 have/has been doing,而不是只表此刻的现在进行时(am/is/are doing);'for two hours / since this morning' 与现在进行时不搭配,故标答唯一为现在完成进行时。

questions.stem: Since the railway opened, Tibetan antelopes ____ these passages every day.
questions.explanation: since the railway opened 表从过去某点持续到现在,动作仍在进行 → have been using;现在进行/一般现在/过去时都无法与 since 从句搭配。

questions.stem: The train ____ steadily across the plateau since it left Xining.
questions.explanation: since it left Xining 表持续至今 → has been racing(主语 the train 单数用 has)。

questions.stem: Workers ____ the delicate wetland to a new area since early this morning.
questions.explanation: since early this morning 表从早上持续到现在 → have been moving。

questions.stem: It ____ over the grassland since dawn, and the ground is soaked now.
questions.explanation: since dawn + 现在已湿透,动作持续至今 → has been raining。

questions.stem: Cattle and sheep ____ across the open grassland since sunrise.
questions.explanation: since sunrise 表持续至今 → have been wandering。

questions.stem: Engineers ____ the massive bridge over the permafrost since last spring.
questions.explanation: since last spring 表从去年春天一直到现在 → have been building。

questions.stem: Water birds ____ in the clear lake since we arrived this afternoon.
questions.explanation: since we arrived 表持续至今 → have been playing。

questions.stem: Ben ____ about the reef on television since June.
questions.explanation: since June 表从六月持续到现在 → has been speaking。

questions.stem: The conservationists ____ the turtles' nests since sunrise.
questions.explanation: since sunrise 表持续至今 → have been watching。

questions.stem: She ____ for the island job ever since the advertisement appeared.
questions.explanation: ever since the advertisement appeared 表持续至今 → has been hoping。

questions.stem: Volunteers ____ trees on the bare hillside since breakfast.
questions.explanation: since breakfast 表持续至今 → have been planting。

questions.stem: The guardian ____ the famous pine tree since he was a young man.
questions.explanation: since he was a young man 表从年轻持续至今 → has been protecting。

questions.stem: For the last twenty minutes, I ____ the headset to explore the rain forest.
questions.explanation: for the last twenty minutes 表到现在为止的一段持续 → have been using。

questions.stem: Tourists ____ the splendid scenery ever since the train began to climb.
questions.explanation: ever since the train began to climb 表持续至今 → have been enjoying。

questions.stem: The Panda Nanny ____ the young pandas since early this morning.
questions.explanation: since early this morning 表持续至今 → has been feeding。

questions.stem: Scientists ____ the reef's delicate ecosystem since the 1970s.
questions.explanation: since the 1970s 表从上世纪七十年代持续至今 → have been studying。

questions.stem: He ____ rubbish from the steep cliffs since nine o'clock.
questions.explanation: since nine o'clock 表持续至今 → has been clearing。

questions.stem: Local people ____ against the new beach hotel since the plan was announced.
questions.explanation: since the plan was announced 表持续至今 → have been arguing。

questions.stem: The oxygen stations ____ the railway workers healthy since the line opened.
questions.explanation: since the line opened 表持续至今 → have been keeping。

questions.stem: Passengers ____ across the high plateau since the railway opened.
questions.explanation: since the railway opened 表持续至今 → have been travelling。

questions.stem: Look at the workers' muddy boots — they ____ in the wetland all morning.
questions.explanation: 靴子沾泥是持续活动留下的现在结果,强调动作一直在进行 → have been working;现在完成时 have worked 强调'已完成',不合此处'活动造成现状'的语境。

questions.stem: The Panda Nanny looks exhausted because she ____ the heavy cubs since dawn.
questions.explanation: exhausted 是持续动作造成的现在状态,强调'一直在抱' → has been carrying。

questions.stem: Ben is out of breath because he ____ up the cliff for the last ten minutes.
questions.explanation: 喘不过气是持续攀爬造成的现在结果 → has been climbing。

questions.stem: Your raincoat is wet through — you ____ in the rain forest, haven't you?
questions.explanation: 湿透是持续活动的现在结果,强调过程 → have been walking。

questions.stem: I wonder how long the volunteers ____ trees out on the hillside today.
questions.explanation: how long 询问动作持续多久,强调过程 → have been planting。

questions.stem: The guardian's hands are dirty because he ____ the mountain path all afternoon.
questions.explanation: 手脏是持续清理留下的现在结果 → has been clearing。

questions.stem: The lake water is muddy because the machines ____ near the shore for hours.
questions.explanation: 湖水变浑是持续作业造成的现在结果 → have been digging。

questions.stem: Rachel is tired but happy; she ____ rhinos at the reserve all day.
questions.explanation: tired 是一整天持续活动造成的现在状态,强调过程 → has been counting。

questions.stem: The conservationists' eyes are red because they ____ at screens for hours.
questions.explanation: 眼睛红是长时间盯屏幕造成的现在结果 → have been staring。

questions.stem: My arms ache because I ____ sandbags down to the lake all morning.
questions.explanation: 胳膊酸是持续搬运造成的现在结果 → have been carrying。

questions.stem: The grass is flat over there, where the antelopes ____ all night.
questions.explanation: 草被压平是动物整夜持续停留留下的现在痕迹 → have been resting。

questions.stem: She is covered in dust because she ____ the red cliffs since lunchtime.
questions.explanation: 满身灰尘是持续攀爬造成的现在结果 → has been climbing。

questions.stem: The hotel operator sounds annoyed; the locals ____ with him for weeks.
questions.explanation: 强调争论持续了数周仍在进行,造成他现在的恼火 → have been arguing。

questions.stem: Look how green the rooftops are now — the city ____ gardens up there for years.
questions.explanation: 屋顶现在很绿是多年持续种植的结果,强调持续过程 → has been growing。

questions.stem: I feel dizzy because I ____ the virtual reality headset for far too long.
questions.explanation: 头晕是长时间持续使用造成的现在结果 → have been using。

questions.stem: The train windows are dusty because we ____ through dry land all day.
questions.explanation: 车窗积尘是一整天持续穿行造成的现在结果 → have been travelling。

questions.stem: Everyone on the platform is wet because it ____ over the plateau since noon.
questions.explanation: 大家淋湿是从中午持续下雨造成的现在结果 → has been raining。

questions.stem: Why are your gloves so dirty? You ____ in the tree nursery again, I see.
questions.explanation: 手套脏是持续劳作造成的现在结果,强调过程 → have been working。

questions.stem: The volunteers look sunburnt because they ____ trees in the open sun all day.
questions.explanation: 晒伤是一整天持续户外活动造成的现在结果 → have been planting。

questions.stem: He is breathing hard because he ____ along the railway line for an hour.
questions.explanation: 喘气是持续奔跑造成的现在结果,强调过程 → has been running。

questions.stem: The conservationist ____ the antelopes through her telescope for over an hour.
questions.explanation: for over an hour 表持续一小时多至今 → has been watching;现在进行时只表此刻,不能带 for + 时间段。

questions.stem: We ____ for the train at this lonely station since noon.
questions.explanation: since noon 表从中午等到现在 → have been waiting;现在进行时不与 since 搭配。

questions.stem: It ____ heavily over the wetland since this morning.
questions.explanation: since this morning 表持续至今 → has been raining。

questions.stem: Rachel and her dad ____ about their holiday plans for the last two hours.
questions.explanation: for the last two hours 表持续两小时至今 → have been talking。

questions.stem: The team ____ the new bridge since the start of the year.
questions.explanation: since the start of the year 表从年初持续至今 → has been building。

questions.stem: I ____ for this island job ever since I first saw the advert.
questions.explanation: ever since I first saw the advert 表持续至今 → have been hoping。

questions.stem: Look at the lake — the workers ____ sandbags along it for weeks.
questions.explanation: for weeks 表持续数周至今 → have been stacking;现在进行时不能带 for + 时间段。

questions.stem: The pandas ____ in the sun since the gate opened this morning.
questions.explanation: since the gate opened 表持续至今 → have been sleeping。

questions.stem: Ben ____ photos of the reef for his weekly blog since April.
questions.explanation: since April 表从四月持续至今 → has been taking。

questions.stem: Scientists ____ the delicate coral for signs of damage for months.
questions.explanation: for months 表持续数月至今 → have been checking。

questions.stem: The guardian ____ up and down the mountain path since sunrise.
questions.explanation: since sunrise 表持续至今 → has been walking。

questions.stem: Volunteers ____ rubbish out of the jungle since early this morning.
questions.explanation: since early this morning 表持续至今 → have been carrying。

questions.stem: Tourists ____ along the famous railway for the whole afternoon.
questions.explanation: for the whole afternoon 表持续整个下午至今 → have been travelling。

questions.stem: My grandfather ____ this art of caring for trees for fifty years.
questions.explanation: for fifty years 表持续五十年至今 → has been practising。

questions.stem: The two sides ____ over the beach hotel since the meeting began.
questions.explanation: since the meeting began 表持续至今 → have been arguing。

questions.stem: She ____ rhinos at the nature reserve since breakfast.
questions.explanation: since breakfast 表持续至今 → has been counting。

questions.stem: The machines ____ near the shore since early today.
questions.explanation: since early today 表持续至今 → have been running。

questions.stem: People ____ to protect this reef for many years now.
questions.explanation: for many years now 表持续多年至今 → have been trying。

questions.stem: The river ____ more slowly ever since the new dam was built.
questions.explanation: ever since the new dam was built 表持续至今 → has been flowing。

questions.stem: The Zhuang people ____ in harmony with this land for hundreds of years.
questions.explanation: for hundreds of years 表持续数百年至今 → have been living;现在进行时不能带 for + 时间段。
